name: github-actions
description: GitHub Actions workflows: pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, untrusted input, secrets and environments, as rules with stable IDs and checks that run.

interface.longDescription: Rules with stable IDs for GitHub Actions (actions pinned by commit SHA, least-privilege permissions, untrusted input, pull_request_target, secrets, environments, release and deploy jobs), plus scripts for the checks that have one right answer.
